seoTitle: Keyword List Cleaner: Remove Duplicates and Near-Duplicates
metaDescription: Clean a keyword list: lowercase, strip symbols, remove duplicates, stop words and near-duplicates such as word order and plurals.
intro: Cleans up exported keyword lists. Removes exact duplicates and, if you wish, near-duplicates (same words in a different order, simple plurals) and stop words, and lists what it removed.
why:
Keyword exports from several tools overlap heavily. Case differences, stray symbols and reordered words make a list longer than it needs to be.

Near-duplicate matching uses a simple English plural rule and ignores word order. That keeps the first form it sees. It can merge keywords with different meanings, so the removed list is shown for review.
howTo: Check the removed list for merges you do not want.

faq.a: The first one in your list.

faq.q: Will it merge "shoe store" and "store shoes"?
faq.a: Yes, with near-duplicates on, because the words are the same. Turn the option off to avoid this.

faq.q: Does it work for other languages?
faq.a: Symbols and exact duplicates work everywhere. Stop words and plurals are English only.

faq.q: Can I keep only longer keywords?
faq.a: Yes, set the minimum words per keyword.
